Hi Sage — thanks for the clear list. Congrats again on being accepted. I’ll outline the operational steps below so you can share with procurement: 

1) Agreement & signature: we require the signed award terms (attached as a short Addendum) before we can finalize invoicing or allocate reserved credits. We can accept an e-signed DocuSign or a scanned PDF.

2) PO / invoicing: Redwood can issue an invoice tied to a PO for the promotional credit amount. Finance prefers a PO that references our deal id (D-2027-TS-114) and the Addendum title. Once we receive the signed Addendum and a PO, we’ll generate an invoice where the award is recorded as a credit line item.

3) Disbursement model: default is milestone-based release to align with program milestones. Typical schedule we use for cohort awards:
- 25% provisional allocation on signed Addendum + completed security questionnaire (to enable initial dev work)
- 50% after onboarding milestone (demo + usage check)
- 25% at program graduation (final review)

If you need a one-time upfront allocation for runway, we can escalate; that would require an approval from finance and a signed PO upfront.

4) Applicability: credits are usable against both Hosted API and Redwood Dedicated in most accelerator awards, but there are account-level constraints for Dedicated (we need to reserve capacity and set an expiry). Ben — FYI on capacity reservation and expiry policy.

5) Security / compliance: please complete the attached security questionnaire so we can clear the account for any Dedicated connectivity. That’s required for the provisional allocation.

Next steps for you:
- Return signed_addendum (DocuSign or PDF)
- Attach PO referencing D-2027-TS-114
- Fill and return security_questionnaire_answers.docx

I’ve CC’d Ben for capacity/expiry details and Lauren for onboarding logistics. If timeline is tight, we can offer a 30-day trial extension on hosted credits once the signed Addendum is in — this gives you extra runway while Dedicated setup completes.

Thanks — I’ll track this on our side and mark the deal for priority onboarding once we have the docs.

— Priya
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference

> I’ve CC’d Ben for capacity/expiry details and Lauren for onboarding logistics.

Sage, quick details from my side on the credit allocation and practical expiry rules: 

- Total promotional credit: $60k equivalent token credits (deal D-2027-TS-114)
- Expiry: 12 months from issuance by default; can be shortened for Dedicated reservations
- Dedicated reservation: if you want credits applied to Dedicated, we need to reserve a slot (1–2 days lead time) and set a 6–month reserved capacity window (unless you request a shorter window)
- Provisional allocation: we can provision up to 25% ($15k) within 48 hours of receiving the signed Addendum and completed security questionnaire
- PO / invoicing: Redwood finance requires PO + signed Addendum to issue an invoice; invoice will net to the credit amount and not produce a cash charge unless you exceed the credit or request a paid commitment

If you prefer a one-off upfront allocation without reserved Dedicated, let us know — we will route for expedited finance approval.

— Ben
